title: Assistant panel: ask, summarize, key insights, citations
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-06 and A-16 work on a real document, with citations that navigate and a stop control
notes: App half of the assistant panel per ADR 0011, serialised after T-0252 and the citation task T-0254. Serves acceptance items A-06 (command bar AI Assistant activates its working tool) and A-16 (ask, summarize, key insights on the open document through OpenCode) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Implements the three placements in the acceptance image (command-bar pill, panel card, rail entry), streamed answers, page citations that navigate to the cited page, a stop control, a per-document conversation, and a 'Connect to OpenCode' state when no service is connected. Document text is untrusted tool output; nothing is sent before the user asks. Depends on T-0254 (citation extraction); until that task record exists and verifies, this task cannot be claimed.
